analysis:
Look, I've been doing this for FOUR DECADES, and let me tell you something about selling low on young tight ends - it NEVER works out! This is the fantasy equivalent of the Texans trading DeAndre Hopkins for a bag of footballs, except Shogunation somehow made Bill O'Brien look like a genius!

Here's what you need to understand about Theo Johnson - I had this kid as a FOOTBALL PLAYER coming out of Penn State. Twenty-four years old, 6'6", athletic tight end with ELITE upside still sitting on my dynasty board. The tape doesn't lie, folks! And Shogunation - "The Draft Capital Dumper" based on that 9-to-5 pick trading deficit - just sold him for a 2028 third-rounder? A 2028 THIRD? That's THREE YEARS from now for a position that takes notoriously long to develop! This is a playoff lock team at 5-2 with a 76.3 power score PUNTING on a rising asset for a dart throw in the Obama administration... I mean, 2028! You don't mortgage developmental talent when you're contending unless you're getting immediate championship pieces back!

Meanwhile, Tishathefish - let's call him "The Bargain Bin Hunter" - is sitting at 3-4, bubble team with a 49.7 power score, and he just acquired a 24-year-old tight end with upside for NOTHING. This is textbook dynasty asset accumulation! The kid's averaging 4.6 PPG as a rookie in what's basically his developmental year, and you're buying at the absolute floor. The age curve on tight ends runs through their late twenties - Johnson has FIVE MORE YEARS of prime ahead of him! On my board, you don't trade rising tight end assets for third-rounders that statistically hit at maybe 15% rates!

The winner here? It's Tishathefish by a LANDSLIDE, and that +296 net value tells the whole story! Shogunation gave up a young, ascending tight end with legitimate TE1 upside for a lottery ticket three years out. This is the kind of move that comes back to haunt you when Johnson is putting up TE6 numbers in 2026-2027 and that third-rounder becomes a backup running back. The tape, the age, the position scarcity - it ALL favors the team getting the player, not the distant pick!
